headline: 10y 5.01% into FOMC, Brent $115.26, Kospi +6.6%, SK Hynix +7.8% pre-market, Robinhood -8%
stance: Fed holds at 2pm; the vote count and Warsh at 2:30 decide the long end. Memory results reopened the AI bid before tonight's hyperscaler prints.

news.head: SK Hynix +7.8% pre-market on record quarter
news.body: Profit up more than 7x y/y, $23bn+ of dividends and buybacks, DRAM and HBM sold out through 2029. Seoul shares +11%; Micron +4% pre-market (~5:50am ET).

news.head: Robinhood -8% pre-market, crypto revenue -55%
news.body: Q3 EPS $0.51 vs $0.55 consensus; revenue $1.42bn vs $1.44bn. Crypto revenue $120m. Net revenue still +12% y/y (~5:25am ET).

news.head: Seagate -3.7% pre-market despite beat and raise
news.body: Revenue $4.2bn, +61% y/y; EPS $7.68; dividend raised to $0.76. Same sell-the-print as Western Digital last week (~5:50am ET).

news.head: Boeing -10.7% Tuesday on wider loss, delivery cut
news.body: Visa -1.2% after hours on a beat; Coca-Cola -1.6% after raising guidance. Deutsche Bank +3.5% early London, Q3 profit +2% (~5:25am ET).

implications: Memory sold out through 2029, storage sold on a beat: AI capex demand is settled, the multiple is not. Tonight's two prints set the multiple.
A hold with hawkish dissents is the 2pm risk. December pricing moves on the vote count, not the statement; 30y 5.32% (~5:20am ET) is the instrument.

watch.head: FOMC 2pm, Warsh 2:30; hold 91% priced
watch.body: No projections this meeting. Dissent count is the first number to read, then any walk-back of July's financial-conditions line.

watch.head: Alphabet, Microsoft after the close
watch.body: Capex guides set the chip bid. Alphabet +1.2% pre-market on a report OpenAI may buy its TPUs (~6am ET). Both report after today's close.

watch.head: ECB Oct 29, 8:15; GDP, PCE, claims 8:30
watch.body: ECB hold at 2.5% expected after September's 25bp hike. Q3 GDP advance and September PCE land 18 hours after the Fed statement.

watch.head: UK budget 8:30am ET; EIA crude today; OPEC+ Nov 1
watch.body: Gilt 30y 5.36%, +2bp (~5:50am ET) into a budget priced as dull. API drew 2.0m bbl. OPEC+ expected to hold targets. ECI and BoJ Oct 30.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: 10y 5.01%, 2y 4.75%, 30y 5.32% (~5:20am ET): back through 5% into the decision. Hold 91% priced, December hike 77%.
Houthis claimed a missile strike on Saudi's largest refinery Tuesday. Brent $115.26, +1.4%; WTI $101.62, +1.7% (~5:30am ET), after a -1.5% Tuesday settle on ceasefire talk.
DXY 102.50, a 2-week high, 4 up days (~4:20am ET); euro 1.1125, yen 157.72 (~5am ET). TTF EUR97.08, a 4-year high. Israel exit polls deadlocked; shekel -1% (~5:50am ET).
sections.positioning: COT Oct 20: silver specs 8th percentile, new this week, -13 points w/w with spot at the 70th. Euro specs 1st percentile a 5th week: background into ECB Oct 29, not a trigger.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Kospi +6.6%, Nikkei +1.1% at the close on memory results. Nasdaq 100 futures +0.45%, S&P +0.1%, Dow -0.2% (~5am ET); Stoxx 600 -0.25% early.
Tuesday: Nasdaq +1.2%, S&P +0.6%, Dow flat; chips up a 3rd straight session. Consumer confidence rose in October, the first gain in 4 months.
Storage sold on a beat for a 2nd week; memory bought instead. Tonight's capex guides decide which of those two patterns the chip complex follows.
sections.positioning: COT Oct 20: Russell 2000 specs 100th percentile a 4th week, VIX shorts 4th percentile a 3rd week. Nothing new this week in equities.

single_name.note: New to the screen today: insider buy filed Oct 14, trade above its 200-day line, 16.8 days to cover. Biotech, not a market read; signal fresh.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: USD IG spreads tightened 2bp+ in Asia Wednesday, a 2nd day (~3am ET). First back-to-back tightening in 5 weeks; the 20-month-longest widening run is over.
Fund flows, week to Oct 21: IG +$1.2bn, HY -$913m, an 8th straight outflow, $6.3bn over the run. The AI bid reached equities before it reached HY.
Refunding Nov 4: the dealer questionnaire asked about shortening issuance. With RRP empty, extra bills come out of reserves; SOFR-OIS is where it shows.
sections.positioning: COT Oct 20: HY specs 13th percentile, new this week, -15 points w/w; dealer IG inventory 19th. Shorts were built into the widening that ended Tuesday.
